// coding-misk · Pioggia sul vetro
// song composed with sections and tracks: each track plays its clips, switched on by the section lane (1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade)
// each .analyze("…") lights up its instrument in the Stage visual
setcpm(78/4)

const SECTIONS = [['Crescendo', 52], ['Vinile', 4], ['A', 8], ['B', 8], ['Pausa', 4], ['Ritorno', 8], ['Coda', 4], ['Stop', 8]]
const TEMPO = {'Crescendo': 78, 'Vinile': 78, 'A': 78, 'B': 78, 'Pausa': 78, 'Ritorno': 78, 'Coda': 78, 'Stop': 78}

// section lanes: 1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade
const section1 = "<1!52 0!44>"  // Crescendo · 52 bars · 78 BPM · D · A#maj7 Am7 Gm7 Fmaj7
const section2 = "<0!52 1!4 0!40>"  // Vinile · 4 bars · 78 BPM · D · A#maj7 Am7 Gm7 Fmaj7
const section3 = "<0!56 1!8 0!32>"  // A · 8 bars · 78 BPM · D · A#maj7 Am7 Gm7 Fmaj7
const section4 = "<0!64 1!8 0.5 0!23>"  // B · 8 bars · 78 BPM · D · A#maj7 Am7 Gm7 Fmaj7

const section7 = "<0!84 1!4 0!8>"  // Coda · 4 bars · 78 BPM · D · A#maj7 Am7 Gm7 Fmaj7
const section8 = "<0!88 1!8>"  // Stop · 8 bars · 78 BPM · D · A#maj7 Am7 Gm7 Fmaj7
